reason: I've never heard of Mëva and there are no reviews, so I'd be paying up front for something I can't check. I took magnesium tablets for weeks last year and felt nothing, and on my budget I can't afford another guess.
objection: Why should I trust a brand nobody I know has tried, when I already wasted money on magnesium that did nothing for me?
would_change_my_mind: Reviews from women my age who say they actually felt less tired after a few weeks, ideally from a shop I already know.
